messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH tail latency detected for inference-service in eu-west-1. 90th/99th spike, errors increased. Severity: P1. Link: https://alerts.internal/INC-1799999991
sara (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge now. @mike can you assist with runtime checks?
mike: On bridge. looking at instance metrics — CPU/GPU look fine, qps up ~30% vs baseline. Starting with cache warmup and kv-cache inspection.
jonah: I'll pull logs and traces. running: `curl https://observability/api/trace?service=inference-service&region=eu-west-1`
sara (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) divert steady traffic to us-east fallback 2) restart a subset of pods in eu-west 3) scale dedicated pool if needed. Starting step 1 now.
mike: Diverted ~20% to us-east via routing policy change. `rbac-route apply --policy failover-eu-to-us` :white_check_mark:
jonah: Found repeated KV cache eviction entries around 12:03UTC. Likely cache thrash after model variant rollover. Posting sample logs: ```evict key=kv_shard_12 size=1.2MB reason=mem_pressure```
tara: Heads-up product/customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers hitting 5xx and timeouts. Paula, can you confirm which accounts are affected?
paula (product): Confirmed 4 customers with elevated error rates (acct: AcmeCorp, Finlytics, EduLabs, Travelly). Notifying AMs. Estimated request loss ~2.6% of total for the hour.
sara (oncall): Proceeding with step 2: rolling restart subset `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-service -n eu-west-1 --selector=group=canary` — will watch latency.
mike: Restarted canaries, latency for canaries dropped ~35% within 3 minutes. Scaling dedicated pool by +2 nodes as precaution.
jonah: Captured timeline notes in the shared doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC-1799999991. Putting initial mitigation timeline in thread.
paula (product): AMs updated; customer communications drafted. Asking for a concise post-incident summary for external comms.
sara (oncall): Looks like root cause is likely cache eviction + unexpected model-variant switch under load. Not confirmed yet. We'll keep timeline and evidence in the doc.
paula (product): Requesting a postmortem meeting 24h from now, 15:00 UTC, to include SRE, runtime, product, and AM owners.
mike: I'll own remediation item: add guardrails to model-variant rollouts (owner: mike). Action item created: `SRE-1799`
jonah: I'll draft RCA timeline and put contributing-factor notes. Will assign to tara for product impact language.
tara: I'll review RCA draft and add customer impact and comms notes. Please ping when draft ready.
sara (oncall): Draft created and shared: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC-1799999991/rca-draft. Asking for peer review by EOD. Please add inline comments.
mike: Left comments on mitigation section. Need to add perf regression tests for rolling variant change.
jonah: Added log excerpts and query samples to evidence section.
paula (product): LGTM on impact summary. Small edit request on timeline wording.
sara (oncall): Thanks all. Once peer review done, I'll mark RCA ready for sign-off and loop in legal for any regulatory check. @legal-bot can you acknowledge when you get pinged?
legal-bot: Acknowledged. Will review for data exposure and customer-regulated language once RCA marked for legal review.
sara (oncall): Final step: schedule postmortem is set, action tracker updated (owners: mike, jonah, tara), and follow-ups assigned. Closing live mitigation. :white_check_mark:
